Theme

Money, work & business

import verb and noun

also imports, importing, importation, imported, importer, imported goods

classical

Caes. BG 4.2.6: vīnum omnīnō ad sē importārī nōn patiuntur
Caes. BG 5.12.5: aere ūtuntur importātō (Lewis & Short)

importō, importāre, importāvī, importātum

verb, first conjugation

bring in from abroad, import

Also, figuratively, to bring on something unwelcome: calamitātem alicui importāre (Cic. Sest. 146, Lewis & Short). It never means “matter” or “be important”: that is rēfert or interest (see important).

Other words

  • invehō, invehere, invexī, invectum — carry in, bring in (goods)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Plin. NH 29.24: peregrīnās mercēs (Lewis & Short); M-O s.v. import (foreign goods)

    To carry in by cart or ship. In the passive it is also to ride or sail in, and invehī in aliquem is to attack someone in words (Lewis & Short).

  • invectiō, invectiōnis f. — import, importing (the noun)

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Off. 2.13

    Cicero’s noun, beside exportātiō (see export). Later Latin also used it for an invective (Lewis & Short).

  • adventīcius, adventīcia, adventīcium — foreign, brought in from outside

    also used · classical · Cic. Rep. 2.7: mercēs … adventīciae

    Coming from outside, foreign; very frequent in Cicero, rare elsewhere (Lewis & Short): imported goods are mercēs adventīciae. Its other senses are “out of the ordinary” and, of money, “come by without one’s own labour”, by inheritance or gift (pecūnia adventīcia, Cic. Rab. Post. 17).

Examples

  • Vīnum omnīnō ad sē importārī nōn patiuntur, quod eā rē ad labōrem ferendum remollēscere hominēs atque effēminārī arbitrantur.

    They do not allow wine to be imported at all, because they think it makes men soft and unmanly in bearing hardship.Caes. BG 4.2.6

  • inportantur nōn mercēs sōlum adventīciae sed etiam mōrēs

    it is not only foreign goods that are imported, but foreign ways as wellCic. Rep. 2.7

See also export, merchant, business, goods, important.
